name: Saab SK 60 Trainer (BAAS Dynamics)
summary: Free community Saab 105 / SK 60 jet trainer mod for DCS World with EFM.
description: Flyable Swedish SK 60 trainer with rebuilt 3D model, KNS-81 nav, radios and custom sounds (v2.x). Installs like any aircraft mod into `Saved Games\DCS\Mods\aircraft`.

releases.changelog: Canopy, visor and gunsight fixes; tinted visor option; gunsight mountable via Mission Editor.
